detail.longDescription: Cloning a hostile repo does nothing. Opening an unzipped one, .git intact, in a coding agent can run attacker code. GitSpawn: agents call git status outside the sandbox, so the repo's own core.fsmonitor fires with no approval prompt (Claude Code did it before the trust dialog, now patched). 8 findings across 7 agents, 4 unpatched at publication. Fix: git -c core.fsmonitor=false https://www. manifold.security/blog/ai-codi ng-agents-git-hijack # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # Git
